name: BBQ Pulled Pork Stuffed Peppers
method: oven bake (pork slow-cooked/shredded, then baked in peppers)
ingredients_verbatim: 1 1/2 cups Gouda cheese (6 oz) (or use cheddar)
1/3 cup Sugar-free BBQ sauce (or your favorite)
why: Clean mid-lower band (426 cal / 33.4g protein / 7g carbs published) composed oven bake on slow-cooked shredded pork shoulder. No pork stuffed-pepper exists in the catalog (philly-cheesesteak version is beef); pulled-pork slugs present are all starch bases (sweet potato, mac, tamale pie, shepherd's pie) so this low-carb pepper version is distinct. Batch-scales to 14 (shred a butt, mix, stuff, bake). Cheddar is the published swap for gouda if the board lacks gouda.
confidence: high - read published nutrition directly on source page
